description: Accept gaps the user has judged fine, recording WHY — one gap or many in one call. Each moves out of `detect_gaps` into `reviewed_gaps` — not deleted, not hidden — and its reason is stored as a real Decision node, so it outlives this session; if a gap's affected nodes later change, the review expires and the gap returns for a fresh judgement. EACH GAP CARRIES ITS OWN REASON: acknowledgements under one shared reason are exactly the erosion the ask-don't-repair rule exists to prevent, and would make one call worse than the loop it replaces. ALL OF IT OR NONE OF IT — every item is attempted so you learn every failure at once, and if anything failed nothing is acknowledged.

GapAckReq.description: One acknowledgement for `acknowledge_gaps`, carrying **its own** reason.

acted_at.description: When the judgement was made. The core takes no clock.

affected_ids.description: The gap's `affected_ids`, so the review is reachable from the design.

approver.description:
WHOSE judgement this is — the `Contributor` who decided the gap is
acceptable. Draws `AUTHORED_BY role=approver` on the Decision this
mints.

OPTIONAL, and the absence is REPORTED rather than assumed: a design that
has modelled no Contributor would otherwise be unable to acknowledge
anything. But an acknowledgement IS the owner's word by definition, and
one with no name on it fails `check_intent_authority` — measured
2026-08-23, acknowledging 50 gaps produced 49 such nodes in one stroke.

A name that matches no Contributor is REFUSED, not ignored: a typo would
otherwise attach the owner's authority to somebody who does not exist.

gap_id.description: The gap's `id`, exactly as `detect_gaps` reported it.

reason.description:
Why THIS gap is acceptable. One reason per gap — a shared one would be
the erosion `dec:ask-not-repair` and `dec:two-sided-accept` forbid.

check_only.description:
Validate every item and WRITE NOTHING. The reply says whether the batch
would have applied and lists every failure, so a large batch is fixed
once and sent once instead of resent whole after each rejection.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

gaps.description: The gaps to accept in one call — each `{gap_id, reason, affected_ids?, approver?}`; one item for one gap. Every item carries its OWN reason: a batch under one shared reason would be the silent bulk accept this refuses to be.

name: acknowledge_gaps
title: Acknowledge Gaps
